name: isuzu-unity-cli
description: Connects Claude Desktop to a running Unity Editor that has the jp.shiranui-isuzu.unity-mcp package installed.
long_description: The bundle carries the isuzu-unity-cli binary for Windows, macOS and Linux. It runs that binary as a stdio bridge to the MCP endpoint the Unity Editor publishes. The Editor must be open with the package installed. Its tools then appear in Claude Desktop: the console, compile status, the scene hierarchy, GameObject and asset authoring, Play Mode, screenshots, Timeline and more.

project.title: Unity project name
project.description: Leave this empty when only one Unity project is open, which is the usual case. With several open, name the one to connect to: either the name in the Editor's title bar, which is the project folder, or the Product Name from Player Settings. The Editor must be open with the jp.shiranui-isuzu.unity-mcp package installed.
